sentences.text: 2023 vs In Re : Anis Ahmed on 4 February, 2026

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh

04.02.2026 In The High Court At Calcutta Item No.8 Criminal Appellate
Jurisdiction Ct.No.35 dc.
C.R.A. (Sb) 7 of 2026 with C.R.A.N. 1 of 2026 In Re : An Application being Cran 1 of 2026 under
Section 389 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 430 of the Bharatiya
Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
And In Re : Anis Ahmed ... Appellant.
Mr. Navanil De, Ms. Monami Mukherjee ... For the Appellant/Applicant.

The order of conviction and sentence reflect that appellant/applicant was convicted and sentenced for one year on account of the offence under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, another one year for the offence under Section 471 of the Indian Penal Code and another six months for the offence under Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code.

Having taken into account the period of sentence which has been imposed by the learned Trial Court, I direct the appellant to continue on the same bail and bond subject to the condition that the appellant shall make himself available as and when called for by the S.P., ACB, CBI, Kolkata.
The application being CRAN 1 of 2026, is, thus, disposed of.
Department is directed to prepare requisite number of paper books within a period of eight weeks from date.
List the appeal along with the paper book under the heading "To Be Mentioned" in the monthly list of May, 2026.
All concerned parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
